pages.title: Build an automatic door
pages.text: Place Door Markers across the floor of an opening. Put a ceiling above them to stop the panels at the intended height. A marker normally fills up to six blocks above itself.$(br2)Unlocked doors open for nearby players and soldiers. The marker’s facing is perpendicular to the width of the opening.

pages.title: Control nearby doors
pages.text: A Lock controls Door Markers within its configured horizontal and vertical range. A matching Key Card toggles the lock and its doors.$(br2)Unlock the controller before adjusting it. Keep control areas separate so two Locks do not compete over one door.$(br2)For a player-built switch-controlled entrance, use a Wireless Lock and Wireless Button.
